title: Sensor telemetry v1
description: One reading from a ground station. Published on MQTT topic sensors/{sensorId}/telemetry and forwarded to Kafka topic telemetry.v1 with the sensor id as key.

sensorId.description: Stable id of the sensor. Must equal the {sensorId} part of the MQTT topic.

ts.description: When the reading was taken, UTC, RFC 3339.

seq.description: Counter that grows by one per reading of this sensor. With sensorId it identifies a reading.

temperatureC.description: Receiver enclosure temperature in degrees Celsius.

signalDbm.description: Mean received signal level in dBm.
